headline: Technology spending varies across sectors while revenue growth remains mixed.
summary: Media & Entertainment shows strong top‑line growth but cost‑cutting pressures. Gaming & Lottery sees digital platform upgrades alongside mixed earnings. Publishing & Information is split between AI‑driven products and revenue declines. Education continues to invest in AI and quantum research with generally positive sentiment.

industries.summary: Revenue is up, led by Disney's $25,248 m Q2 result. Companies are investing in AI and cutting costs. Private players like Cox are expanding tech spend.

leaders.why: Largest revenue at $25,248 m and operating margin 22%.

laggards.why: Neutral sentiment and no disclosed financials.

themes.title: AI investment
themes.detail: Disney filed a real‑time AI patent and Wolters Kluwer launched multiple AI tools.

themes.title: Cost cutting
themes.detail: Disney targets 20% staff reductions; WBD/Skydance seeks $6 bn synergies.

industries.it_note: Tech spend is tightening at large studios but expanding at niche players; account teams should balance cost‑efficiency with AI enablement.

industries.summary: Revenue growth is modest with Caesars reporting a loss despite $2,940 m revenue. Digital casino platforms are being rolled out. Margin pressure varies widely.

laggards.why: Lowest revenue at $824 m and negative YoY growth.

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: Caesars launched Empire Builder; Light & Wonder introduced RAPIDPLAY cashless slots.

industries.it_note: While some firms expand digital spend, others remain cautious; focus on scalable platform solutions.

industries.summary: Pearson shows strong growth with $1,779 m revenue, while Scholastic missed targets at $216.8 m. AI tools are a common focus. Overall sentiment is split.

leaders.why: Largest revenue at $1,779 m and positive margin.

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Pearson and Wolters Kluwer rolled out AI‑driven learning and tax tools.

industries.it_note: AI initiatives are accelerating; account teams should highlight integration and data‑analytics capabilities.

industries.summary: Pearson and NYU report strong AI and quantum research investments. Revenue data is limited but sentiment is upbeat. Outsourcing and partnership trends appear.

leaders.why: Revenue $1,779 m and expanding AI portfolio.

laggards.why: No financial data and neutral sentiment.

themes.title: AI research and deployment
themes.detail: NYU builds AI for archaeology and student interaction; Pearson embeds AI across learning products.

industries.it_note: Institutions are scaling AI labs and partnerships; teams should position advanced analytics and cloud services.
